steps.content: You land flat on your back amidst the shattered stones, a jagged point piercing your shoulder. Warm, thick blood glues your clothes to your skin.
And there, through the swirling dust that has yet to settle, Lichen's silhouette grows steadily clearer.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: That boy always loved it when we played this game.
steps.female_content: That girl always loved it when we played this game.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: I'd always pretend I couldn't find him, just to make him happy.
steps.female_content: I'd always pretend I couldn't find her, just to make her happy.

steps.content: She sinks into a crouch before you, head tilting, a smile playing at her lips. It is almost the same look she wore the very first time you met.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: But playtime is over. No more hide-and-seek.

Her hand reaches toward you, pausing in the air just before your face, then drifts down to your collar. Through the fabric, her cool fingertips press hard against your collarbone and suddenly grip with terrible force.
She lifts you as though you weigh nothing. Your legs kick at empty air while your hands grasp desperately at her wrist.
There, just behind you, the last stone stele marking the exit stands in silence.
There is nowhere left to run.
